title: GST 114 ( UNN ) : CHAPTER TWELVE ( ESSAY WRITING )
subject: GST 114

questions.question: Writing is described as an opportunity to express one's which of the following?
questions.explanation: Writing is described as an opportunity to express one's point of view.

questions.question: Writing helps to open up which part of life?
questions.explanation: Writing is an opportunity to open up one's imagination.

questions.question: The main purpose of writing is to do which of the following?
questions.explanation: The main purpose of writing is communication.

questions.question: Communication through writing involves what?
questions.explanation: Communication through writing involves sharing feelings and ideas.

questions.question: Writing is viewed as a form of which of the following?
questions.explanation: Writing is a form of linguistic organisation.

questions.question: Writing is a process that involves which of the following?
questions.explanation: Writing involves careful thought.

questions.question: An essay is described as which type of writing?
questions.explanation: An essay is a short piece of writing.

questions.question: An essay usually discusses a subject from which perspective?
questions.explanation: An essay discusses a subject from a single point of view.

questions.question: An essay can be described as a composition that does what?
questions.explanation: An essay is a composition that articulates ideas.

questions.question: The essay is described as a piece of what?
questions.explanation: An essay is a piece of continuous writing.

questions.question: An essay attempts to analyse or interpret something in which way?
questions.explanation: An essay attempts to analyse or interpret something in a personal way.

questions.question: Traditional essays are categorised under which types?
questions.explanation: Traditional essays are categorised into narration, description, exposition, and argumentation.

questions.question: Social correspondence includes which type of writing?
questions.explanation: Social correspondence includes letter writing.

questions.question: Technical writing includes which of the following?
questions.explanation: Technical writing includes reports, minutes, and speeches.

questions.question: Creative writing includes which type of writing?
questions.explanation: Creative writing includes poetry, drama, and stories.

questions.question: A narrative essay is primarily concerned with which of the following?
questions.explanation: A narrative essay is primarily concerned with story-telling.

questions.question: Narrative essays contain which element of believability?
questions.explanation: Narrative essays contain an element of believability.

questions.question: Which of the following is an element of narrative essays?
questions.explanation: Narrative essays contain elements such as theme, setting, and plot.

questions.question: The purpose of a narrative essay is to do which of the following?
questions.explanation: The purpose of a narrative essay is to tell a story.

questions.question: A descriptive essay gives a vivid description of which of the following?
questions.explanation: A descriptive essay gives a vivid description of a person, animal, or place.

questions.question: Descriptive essays use which part of speech copiously?
questions.explanation: Descriptive essays make copious use of adjectives.

questions.question: The reader does not need to ask questions of what kind in a descriptive essay?
questions.explanation: The reader does not need to ask questions of direction in a descriptive essay.

questions.question: The purpose of a descriptive essay is to do what?
questions.explanation: The purpose of a descriptive essay is to paint a picture with words.

questions.question: An expository essay exposes a body of what?
questions.explanation: An expository essay exposes a body of facts.

questions.question: Expository essays are always used to do which of the following?
questions.explanation: Expository essays are always used to explain issues.

questions.question: An expository essay may need to do which of the following?
questions.explanation: An expository essay may need to argue or give an account of an incident.

questions.question: An argumentative essay expresses which of the following?
questions.explanation: An argumentative essay expresses opinions on a topic with reasons.

questions.question: Argumentation employs which tool for effectiveness?
questions.explanation: Argumentation employs sound reasoning as a tool for effectiveness.

questions.question: The purpose of an argumentative essay is to do what?
questions.explanation: The purpose of an argumentative essay is to convince the audience.

questions.question: Coherence refers to which principle?
questions.explanation: Coherence refers to the principle of order in a paragraph or essay.

questions.question: Which linking devices help achieve coherence?
questions.explanation: Coherence is achieved using paragraph connectors or linking devices.

questions.question: Unity is the principle of what?
questions.explanation: Unity is the principle of oneness in a paragraph or essay.

questions.question: In an essay, all sentences must relate to which element?
questions.explanation: All sentences in an essay must relate to the main idea.

questions.question: What does the introduction of an essay do?
questions.explanation: The introduction introduces readers into the thesis or main point.

questions.question: How many sentences can an introduction be according to Anohu?
questions.explanation: An introduction can be in two or three sentences.

questions.question: The body of an essay is the site for what?
questions.explanation: The body is the site for expansive elaboration of points.

questions.question: How many broad steps are there in essay writing?
questions.explanation: There are four broad steps in essay writing.

questions.question: Pre-writing includes which activity?
questions.explanation: Pre-writing includes selection of topic and gathering materials.

questions.question: In an examination situation, brainstorming involves what?
questions.explanation: Brainstorming involves thinking about your topic and putting down ideas.

questions.question: The first step in drafting is to find freedom from which of the following?
questions.explanation: The first step in drafting is to find freedom from distraction.

questions.question: During drafting, the writer should not worry about which of the following?
questions.explanation: The writer should not worry about spelling during drafting.

questions.question: Transitional words are used to do what?
questions.explanation: Transitional words are used to link your ideas.

questions.question: Revising means going back to what?
questions.explanation: Revising means going back to your draft.

questions.question: Which element is eliminated during revision?
questions.explanation: Revision eliminates wordiness, repetitions, and irrelevancies.

questions.question: Proofreading focuses on which of the following?
questions.explanation: Proofreading looks at mechanics and grammar.

questions.question: Which element is checked during proofreading?
questions.explanation: Proofreading checks for punctuation and mechanics.

questions.question: A thesis statement should capture the content of which element?
questions.explanation: A thesis statement captures the content of each paragraph.

questions.question: Transitional devices should connect what?
questions.explanation: Transitional devices connect paragraphs.

questions.question: Writing brings out what in people?
questions.explanation: Writing brings out the best in people.

questions.question: What can only be proven by what we write?
questions.explanation: What we know can only be proven by what we write.
